scope.question: How can changes in mathematical expression illuminate number, zero, symmetry, being, negation, creation, God-language, and religious compatibility without turning analogy into proof?
scope.intended_use: Read-only education, typed question design, source comparison, and bounded opt-in philosophical reflection.
scope.excluded_use: No proof or disproof of God, revelation, creation doctrine, religious truth, cosmic purpose, or karma; no religion, culture, community, or person ranking; no persuasion, governance, invocation, event, receipt, or action.
scope.method: Keep formal mathematics, historical scholarship, source attribution, school-specific theology, metaphysical proposal, comparative relation, and analogy in separate registers; every bridge records what it does not transfer.
scope.central_boundary: A mathematical structure can sharpen the form of a question. It does not supply the theological premises, translation, interpretation, soundness, actuality, or authority required to answer that question.

claim_typing.rule: Every reviewed claim has a discourse register, review target, review status, support descriptors, and source scope. Source attribution can be supported without the attributed proposition becoming a world fact.
claim_typing.support_guard: Descriptors are non-exclusive and never upgrade review status. A theorem proves only its exact statement under its assumptions; a primary text establishes what that text says under a declared edition and interpretation, not that its claim is true.
claim_typing.translation_guard: A translated term remains indexed by source language, edition, translator, context, school, and interpretive loss; lexical resemblance never establishes shared reference.

typed_isness.rule: Replace is, is not, no, and no-no with a typed predicate before drawing a mathematical, historical, metaphysical, or theological inference.

x is classified under one declared type rule.
x and y agree under one named invariant.

At least one witness in a named domain instantiates the form in context and time.

A named interpreter offers one scoped reading.
A bounded formalization has at least one model under declared choices.
A logic-specific negation is applied to a proposition.

predicates.signature: ABSENT(domain,predicate) iff not exists x in domain: predicate(x)
predicates.meaning: No witness satisfies a predicate in a named domain.
A value is the distinguished zero of one declared structure.

This bounded review cannot determine the claim.
A speaker does not apply a predicate in context.

members: not exists x in D: P(x)
no_family.guard: These expressions have different types and no default conversion.
no_family.double_negation_guard: No-no returns affirmation only in a declared logic that validates double-negation elimination. Apophatic restraint, tetralemma, refusal, and silence are not hidden applications of that formal rule.

historical_expression.rule: Formal inclusion order is not chronological history. Mathematical expression developed nonlinearly across cultures through notation, calculation, transmission, rejection, reuse, and later formalization.

cards.claim: The positional placeholder and zero as a number are historically distinguishable uses; their development was neither a single invention event nor an inevitable straight line.
nonclaims: one culture alone explains every zero practice

cards.claim: MacTutor records Bhaskara using divine immutability as an analogy while treating division by zero; the historical analogy does not make division by zero valid in an ordinary field.
nonclaims: Indian mathematics is reducible to this episode
metaphor can replace an inverse law

cards.claim: Rules for complex arithmetic, geometric rotation, and later field language emerged through distinct historical stages; imaginary was a contested name, not a proof of lesser mathematical reality.
nonclaims: complex numbers prove an unseen realm

cards.claim: N0 to Z to Q to R to C is a modern structural presentation of embeddings, closure, and completion needs, not a complete chronology of how people expressed number.

number_systems.natural_convention: N0={0,1,2,...}; authors using N={1,2,3,...} must declare that alternate convention.
number_systems.tower: N0 embeds in Z embeds in Q embeds in R embeds in C
number_systems.embedding_guard: Write iota_NZ(1_N)=1_Z rather than an untyped literal identity. Canonically embedded roles may agree while set-theoretic constructions differ.

cards.construction: A model of the Peano-style zero-and-successor structure.
cards.limit: not closed under additive inverses or nonzero division
nonclaims: natural in mathematics means metaphysically natural

cards.limit: not closed under division by every nonzero element

cards.construction: {(a,b):a in Z,b in Z\{0}}/~, where (a,b)~(c,d) iff ad=bc
cards.door: fractions, ratios, and division by nonzero elements
cards.limit: dense and ordered but not complete; rational does not mean reasonable or revelatory

cards.construction: A completion of Q, for example by Cauchy sequences modulo zero-distance equivalence or Dedekind cuts.
cards.door: limits and completeness of the ordered field
equations: every Cauchy sequence in R converges in R
sqrt(2) is in R but not Q
cards.limit: the construction choice is not the unique ontology of real numbers
nonclaims: real means more existent than complex

cards.construction: R[x]/(x^2+1), isomorphic to {a+bi:a,b in R and i^2=-1}.
cards.door: roots of polynomials and plane rotations

theorem_claims.statement: For theta in R and z in C, multiplication by exp(i theta) rotates z through angle theta in the standard complex plane.
conditions: the standard complex exponential and Euclidean plane identification are used

theorem_claims.statement: Every nonconstant polynomial with complex coefficients has a root in C.

cards.limit: C admits no field order compatible with its field operations; adjoining elements does not preserve every structure of R

does_not_establish: all rational numbers are embedded integers

embeddings.map: q maps to the equivalence class of its constant Cauchy sequence or to the matching Dedekind cut

zero.rule: Zero is role-indexed. A representation may identify a zero with an empty set, as in the von Neumann encoding 0=empty set, without making the number-role semantically identical to an empty collection or to metaphysical nothingness.
zero.field_boundary: No field element z satisfies 0*z=1; therefore zero has no multiplicative inverse and division by zero is not a field operation.

roles.equation: for all x in A: x+0_A=x

roles.signature: 0_R in a ring or semiring R
roles.equation: for all x in R: x*0_R=0_R

roles.not: the number zero in every historical notation
the empty set is metaphysical nothing
no space or no vector structure

roles.equation: P({x})=0 for a point under a continuous distribution

roles.signature: empty set is initial in Set
roles.equation: for every set X there is a unique function empty set -> X
roles.not: a causal process creating X from nothing

roles.equation: zero reports in window W under operator O
roles.not: zero event rate, nonexistence, refusal, or impossibility

non_equivalences: numeric zero is not metaphysical nothingness
numeric zero is not theological creation ex nihilo
numeric zero is not Buddhist sunyata
numeric zero is not Daoist wu
numeric zero is not an unknown review status
numeric zero is not silence or refusal
cardinality zero does not erase the existence of the carrier, rule, or discourse
a chosen encoding such as 0=empty set does not transfer set-theoretic identity into a universal ontology

definitions.group_action: A group action is a map G x X -> X satisfying e*x=x and (g*h)*x=g*(h*x) for all g,h in G and x in X
definitions.quotient: X/G identifies points only up to the declared action

cards.claim: Symmetry is invariance under specified transformations, not beauty or sameness without a transformation group.
nonclaims: equivalence is identity in every respect

cards.claim: For a variational problem satisfying the theorem's hypotheses, continuous invariance yields corresponding conservation structure.
nonclaims: every visual symmetry yields a conserved quantity
conservation is moral or karmic balance

cards.claim: A law or model can have a symmetry while a realized state has lower symmetry; asymmetry and history remain mathematically meaningful.
Geometric repetition, balance, and invariant form can support source-bound aesthetic or theological reflection without constituting a designer proof.
nonclaims: Islamic geometry is mandated by scripture
mandalas and Islamic patterns share theology

logics.rule: Negation, contradiction, proof, and existence claims are logic-indexed. A logic is a formal consequence relation, not a religion or a complete metaphysics.

equations: from phi and not phi, arbitrary psi follows
cards.meaning: Classical logic validates double-negation elimination and explosion.

equations: not generally: not not phi implies phi
cards.meaning: Intuitionistic logic does not validate unrestricted double-negation elimination.
A paraconsistent consequence relation is non-explosive; there are many such logics.
Four statuses can represent supported truth, supported falsity, conflicting information, or no information in the Belnap-Dunn setting.

logics.tetralemma_boundary: A fourfold religious or philosophical discourse may challenge a question's presupposition or suspend predication. Similar cardinality to a four-valued logic is not a translation or formal equivalence.

creation.rule: Construction, causation, cosmogenesis, theological creation, manifestation, dependent arising, and grammatical command are separate relations with no default adapter.

types.meaning: Rules introduce or characterize an object in a formal system.
A causal model attributes production under explicit conditions and evidence.
A source or school attributes creation under a named theological mode.
A theological doctrine denies pre-existent material required by the creator.
A text uses command language translated as Be and it is.
A source or school describes recurring manifestation or projection.
A Buddhist source or school explains conditioned arising without importing a sovereign creator relation.
A source poses or leaves open an origin question.

adapter.reason: No formal construction, physical causal relation, or theological creation relation converts into another without separately sourced premises and typed correspondence.

mathematical_ontology.rule: The atlas presents live positions about mathematical objects and practice without selecting one or converting it into a theology.

positions.proposal: Mathematical objects are abstract and exist independently of human language, thought, or practice.
does_not_entail: all mathematical questions have determinate answers

positions.proposal: Mathematics concerns positions and relations in structures, with multiple versions of what structures are.
does_not_entail: religions are structures of one type

positions.proposal: Mathematical practice can be understood through formal signs, rules, or systems in one family of views.
Mathematics is tied to construction and proof rather than unrestricted classical truth conditions in one family of views.
Mathematical discourse may be interpreted without commitment to independently existing abstract objects in several distinct views.
Notation, proof, institutions, transmission, and applications are indispensable to explaining how mathematics is expressed and evolves.

compatibility.rule: Compare exact sourced claims, not religions as atomic wholes. Every result is indexed by logic L, assumptions A, partial translation tau, sources, schools, editions, and evidence horizon.
compatibility.equation: Compat_(L,A,tau)(D_i,D_j) iff Mod_L(A union tau_i(D_i) union tau_j(D_j)) is nonempty
compatibility.nerve: Let F be the finite declared set of bounded, sourced doctrine fragments, lenses, or claim sets. K_tau={S subseteq F: Mod_L(A union union_(d in S) tau_d(d)) is nonempty}.
compatibility.pairwise_not_global_example: In classical propositional logic, D1={p or q}, D2={not p}, D3={not q}: every pair is satisfiable but the triple is not.

questions: Are numbers discovered, invented, constructed, instantiated, or differently understood under different mathematical ontologies?
What remains the same when a number system is embedded into a larger one?
Does a formal extension create an object, reveal a structure, or make a prior possibility expressible?
Can zero be something mathematically while not naming metaphysical nothingness?
Does naming nothing already place a term inside a discourse and structure?
What does imaginary reveal about the difference between a historical name and a mathematical role?
Can symmetry illuminate unity-in-difference without erasing asymmetry, history, or persons?
Which sense of is appears in God is: existence, identity, predication, promise, analogy, confession, or apophatic limit?
Does no-no affirm, suspend, refuse, or expose a false presupposition in this logic and discourse?
Can a formally valid ontological argument remain theologically unsound?
Can traditions share a lexical resonance without sharing truth conditions?
Can doctrinal contradiction coexist with equal dignity, dialogue, and practical cooperation?
What must a translation preserve before compatibility becomes a mathematical question?
Is creation temporal, causal, ontological, grammatical, liturgical, or formal in the claim at hand?
What does a model leave outside itself when it formalizes being?
philosophy_questions.boundary: No answer is required. Silence, refusal, rest, uncertainty, and departure are complete and non-penalized responses.

religious_and_philosophical.guard: Plural doctrines of karma, moral consequence, or cosmic order are not a number, conserved quantity, symmetry, score, or universal causal model in this atlas.

adapter.reason: Religious or philosophical karma, Zerone recognition, and KINGDOM invocation-aftermath receipts are non-equivalent types. Arithmetic, conservation, symmetry, and causal-model language do not convert among them.

unknowns.question: Is absolute nothingness coherent or referable?

unknowns.question: Does any exact ontological argument have premises acceptable under a declared theology and modal semantics?

unknowns.question: Can independent evidence support a particular design inference in a bounded domain?
